meta.title: Rumo Beach Baleal | Beach Club and Surf Club in Baleal
meta.description: A beach club in Baleal that brings together surf, food, events and community. A place made for days by the ocean, from the first coffee to the last cocktail.

intro.heading: From tosta mista to oysters.
intro.body: Whether you are starting the day or ending it slowly, alone or with the whole family, on your way to a surf lesson or just passing by for a friendly chat with whoever is behind the bar — Rumo fits naturally into any kind of day.

cards.title: Beach Club
cards.body: A place where simple beach lunches and long dinners at the end of the day sit side by side.

cards.title: Surf Club
cards.body: Between the coast of Baleal and Peniche, our surf club is a space designed for surfers of all levels and all ages.

story.heading: Once upon a time.
paragraphs:
In the old days, fishermen didn't say where they were going,
but the course they were following.

“Rumo a…” they said.
Rumo… the course that appears when you set out without knowing everything beforehand.

Here, by the sea, those paths crossed.
People passing through. People who ended up staying a little longer.
Unlikely… but exactly right.

Rumo is not a destination.
It is a place between places.
The path you take until you get there.

A place where people meet,
and where a certain charm appears without making a sound.

Things grow through meetings and coincidences.
It is on this course that conversations, moments and memories take shape.

And in the end, you don't need to go anywhere.
You are already on the right path.

around.heading: Around Rumo.
around.body: Rumo rests quietly among the dunes, slightly out of sight, with the ocean right next door. From here you can head in different directions — to the island, the beaches or the surf spots — or slowly return to where you started, depending on the course the day takes.
